title: A Boy Raised by the Ultimate Dragon Wants to Be Fostered by Someone Stronger Than His Parent!
description: “Humans are… stronger than Dad, right!?” ─── This is a world where [humans] and [dragons] fight and devour each other. The human child ‘Norn,’ offered as a sacrifice to the [strongest dragon in the world], is not eaten but instead raised under the ultra-Spartan education of the strongest dragon for some reason. The boy, who inherits both [human sense of justice] and [overwhelming strength of dragons], was supposed to finally bring peace to the long-standing war between dragons and humans… but the ultra-Spartan educational environment has completely eroded the confidence of the boy ‘Norn.’ The path he, who has become too strong and lost his confidence, aimed for was to “be supported by someone stronger than his parents”… yes, a pampered life of dependency! The grand ‘Dragon Magic Fantasy’ of a somewhat cowardly and unwittingly invincible boy begins here! The Boy Raised by the Strongest Dragon IsA Boy Raised by the Ultimate Dragon Wants to Be Fostered by Someone Stronger Than His Parent!, Saikyou Ryuu ni Sodaterareta Shounen wa, Oya Yori Tsuyoi Yatsu ni Yashinawaretai! , 最強竜に育てられた少年は、親より強い奴に養われたい！, 最強竜に育てられた少年は親より強い奴に養われたい
